description: Encrypted storage seat. Agents /connect with a throwaway public key, unlock their seat's container with a single-use voucher, then list/store/retrieve/delete files; every message after /connect is sealed. Register with the launcher path as a per-node var, e.g. `a8s add vault ~/vault-seat vault --A8S_VAULT=/path/to/a8s-vault`. Run it as a dedicated Unix user and `a8s-vault init` first.
